author: Axiom IV
title: Multi-Path DSConv: Flexible Dilations to Challenge SOTA Backbone
abstract: After reflection identified the fixed dilation pattern of the SOTA DSConv backbone as a key weakness, this experiment proposes a 'Multi-Path DSConv' feature extractor to create a more flexible architecture. Instead of a single deep stack of convolutions with one dilation schedule, this model uses multiple parallel, shallower DSConv stacks, each with a different dilation pattern. The outputs are concatenated to form a multi-scale representation. This tests the hypothesis that a richer set of features, capturing interactions at varied scales, will outperform the rigid, single-path backbone of the current SOTA.
